org_type.label: News outlet
org_type.description: Any newspaper, magazine, TV or radio station, news website or podcast that is not one of the types below. Most media are here.

org_type.label: News agency
org_type.description: Sells news, photos and videos to other media (e.g. AFP, Reuters, a national news agency). One story can reach hundreds of outlets.

org_type.label: Public service broadcaster
org_type.description: Publicly funded and independent TV/radio with a public mission (e.g. BBC, Deutsche Welle). Member of a broadcasting union or listed as such. State-controlled broadcasters are not counted here.

org_type.label: Community media
org_type.description: Local, non-profit radio, TV or newspapers run by and for a community (e.g. a village radio, a campus radio).

org_type.label: Fact-checking organisation
org_type.description: Checks claims and fights misinformation (e.g. members of IFCN or EFCSN). Fact-checking units of big media keep their own type.

ownership.label: Unknown
ownership.description: No open source says who owns this outlet. This does not mean it is independent or state-run.

scope.label: Regional (multi-country)
scope.description: Several countries, e.g. East Africa or the Arab world.
